name: Crying Wojak vs Yes Chad
look: Two simple drawings on a white background. Left: a balding wojak face in glasses, red-eyed and crying blue tears, yelling with its mouth wide open. Right: a calm, blond, bearded man with a neat haircut, shown in profile in a black shirt.
use: An overreaction against calm acceptance. The crying wojak shouts an outraged accusation or complaint, and the bearded Chad answers unbothered, usually with a simple yes, owning whatever he is accused of.
slots: the calm reply, usually just yes (right, Chad)
examples: You can't just eat cereal for dinner!
You've already watched that movie twelve times!
And I'll watch it again tonight.
describe: crying nerd with glasses yelling at a calm bearded guy
wojak screaming and a blond chad saying yes
angry crying cartoon face vs cool guy with a beard
soyjak meltdown next to a calm nordic gamer
drawing of a man with a blond beard in profile staying calm
origin: Pairs the crying soyjak wojak drawing with the bearded Nordic Gamer drawing, better known as Yes Chad.
